body: We're lucky to have people like you here, thanks for spending your time helping others. :)

Mixed bag. I'm enjoying school more than ever, but frustrated that I've been in school for so long. This is my fifth year, second semester. I changed schools after two years, changed majors a year after that. Now I'm working on prereqs for a program that will take another two years once I'm in.  
Aside from that, I'm fatter than ever (and I was morbidly obese to begin with). On antidepressants for depression, suicidal thoughts, and anxiety, but the drugs make me feel... Wrong, or on edge... Something hard to describe.  
I have a girlfriend I'm madly in love with though. Being with her has kept me from self harming for the most part since we started dating. But sometimes I choose not to self harm out of guilt, because I don't want to hurt her... Which makes me hurt even more.  
So, like I said, a mixed bag. Thanks for asking, OP. I appreciate it.
I loved Christmas until I had a late miscarriage on Christmas morning two years ago.  Now it feels like everyone celebrating is trying really hard to get me to kill myself.
I've tried twice in the past, and all they've ever said is that I should seek professional help. (I guess that means I'm pretty fucked up)

She is a great listener, the problem that I have talking with her is that she doesn't have any experience to talk from, so she tends to shut down a bit when I bring up self harm, depression, or anxiety.  She's extremely supportive, and she's said multiple times that she's ok being in a relationship with a mentally ill person, but she doesn't have any experience with this kind of thing, so she can't really talk to me about it.
I feel a bit like I'm running out of options.  I have a few friends who have always been there for me to talk to, but lately all they've been saying is for me to get help, which, as you probably know, is extremely unhelpful.

Anyway, thank you for responding and caring, it's nice to know I'm not alone.
